description:
## [1.53.0](https://github.com/latanvillegas/modo-patches/compare/v1.52.2...v1.53.0) (2026-10-30)

### ✨ New Features

* **tv360:** integrate Bitel Huawei 1.6 patches and independent Media3 player ([8d876bc](https://github.com/latanvillegas/modo-patches/commit/8d876bc290be4d84971af3ec9b7d5bbfe946bc4a))

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Audio Cover Thumbnails
patches.description: Adds WAV/APIC cover thumbnails after native and MediaStore lookup fail; other audio formats retain their original artwork.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - High Quality Album Art
patches.description: Uses full-resolution album artwork, ARGB_8888 decoding, and WAV/ID3v2.3 APIC fallback when Android finds no embedded cover.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Premium (local feature gate experimental)
patches.description: Activa el control local principal de funciones Premium sin consulta de red en ese control. Oculta controles de caducidad/suscripción en la interfaz Premium; no crea una licencia vitalicia firmada ni elimina Billing.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy
patches.description: Desactiva las estadísticas de uso y los eventos de Analytics controlados por usage_diagnostics en File Manager Plus 3.8.2.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v2 (Sessions experimental)
patches.description: Desactiva Firebase Sessions mediante su control de configuración; requiere pruebas en Android.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v3 (Ad requests experimental)
patches.description: Evita solicitudes de banners y anuncios nativos, notificando fallo a la interfaz. Requiere pruebas en Android.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v3 (App Open Ads experimental)
patches.description: Impide iniciar y solicitar anuncios de apertura. No desactiva banners ni anuncios nativos.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v3 (Crashlytics experimental)
patches.description: Desactiva la recopilación automática de Crashlytics mediante su control interno. No bloquea todavía AdMob.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v4 (Ad placement gates experimental)
patches.description: Desactiva ocho controles de anuncios sin eliminar bibliotecas ni alterar licencias o temas. Experimental.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Privacy v4 (Remote Config experimental)
patches.description: Evita la descarga de Firebase Remote Config y conserva los valores locales. Experimental.

patches.name: File Manager Plus - Pure AMOLED
patches.description: Separa superficies blancas en modo claro y negras AMOLED en modo oscuro; conserva la selección de tema en File Manager Plus 3.8.2.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Android 16 HyperOS Black Bars
patches.description: Android 16 phones show an AMOLED-black status bar with white icons; tablets retain their immersive behavior.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Expand Behind Status Bar
patches.description: Preserves top-edge layout across two TV360 UI resets; does not move content behind bottom navigation.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Experimental Picture in Picture
patches.description: Auto-enter Android 12+ PiP only when the Alticast player reports active playback; requires device testing.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Hide Status Bar
patches.description: Requests status-bar-only hiding on Android 15 and reapplies it when TV360 resumes; keeps bottom navigation.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - My Media3 Player
patches.description: Adds a visible top-right Media3 launcher for HTTP(S), local files, IPTV M3U, external subtitles and safe favourites. Does not replace TV360 playback.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Optional Analytics Privacy
patches.description: Sets optional Firebase Analytics and Facebook automatic event collection opt-outs.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Optional Crash Reports Privacy
patches.description: Disables automatic Firebase Crashlytics collection via manifest metadata.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Pure AMOLED Black
patches.description: Makes verified dark TV360 interface surfaces #000000 while retaining text, red accents, posters and video.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Sensor Rotation
patches.description: Allows the main activity to follow the device sensor in portrait and landscape.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Sensor Rotation (Runtime)
patches.description: Applies device-sensor rotation to the home activity's three verified orientation requests.

patches.name: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Video Resize (Fit / Fill)
patches.description: Select FIT (no crop) or FILL (crop-to-fill) in Morphe before rebuilding the APK; not a runtime player menu.

options.description: Se elige al parchear; para cambiarlo hay que generar otra APK.

patches.name: Movie - Hide status bar
patches.description: Hides the Android status bar and removes the window's top layout reservation without hiding bottom navigation.

patches.name: Movie - Native Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enter native Android PiP when leaving the Movie video player.

patches.name: Movie - Pure AMOLED
patches.description: Makes verified Movie interface surfaces pure black.

patches.name: Movie - Remove status bar spacing
patches.description: Removes Movie-owned status bar spacers, including their runtime measured height, and home header top spacing.

patches.name: Movie - Video Quality Selector
patches.description: Adds a fullscreen video quality popup using real ExoPlayer tracks and preserves audio/subtitle overrides.

patches.name: AMOLED - App menu
patches.description: Restores native AppMenu resources and three verified bytecode injections.

patches.name: AMOLED - Context menu
patches.description: Applies Device default / Pure Black / Pure White to the verified Cromite context-menu content surface while preserving the transparent outer dialog window.

patches.name: AMOLED - New Tab Page (tile resources)
patches.description: Recovers original NTP tile icon background resources; NewTabPageLayout and Most Visited DEX changes remain pending.

patches.name: AMOLED - Omnibox and search UI
patches.description: Uses the saved runtime theme for verified LocationBarTablet background setters.

patches.name: AMOLED - Settings
patches.description: Uses the saved runtime theme for SettingsActivity, preference backgrounds and containment-card colors.

patches.name: AMOLED - Tabs and tab strip
patches.description: Resolves saved System / Pure Black / Pure White at runtime for the tab grid dialog surface.

patches.name: AMOLED - Toolbar
patches.description: Uses the saved runtime AMOLED theme for the verified Cromite ToolbarTablet background setter.

patches.name: AMOLED automatic web darkening
patches.description: Adds automatic AMOLED web darkening while retaining Cromite's manual and per-site darkening.

patches.name: Cromite AMOLED native theme runtime
patches.description: Bundles the native pure-color runtime without installing a duplicate theme or brightness dialog.

patches.name: Cromite AMOLED settings entry
patches.description: Adds the AMOLED and brightness entry to Cromite theme settings.

patches.name: Cromite DevTools: native COPY button (experimental)
patches.description: Embed verified DevTools frontend and bootstrap for Cromite 153; runtime behavior unverified.

patches.name: Cromite automatic web darkening with native theme
patches.description: Synchronizes the existing web-darkening checkbox on theme changes, preserving manual toggles and site exceptions.

patches.name: Cromite web AMOLED decision guard (verification only)
patches.description: Validates Cromite's web darkening decision structure without changing its behavior.

patches.name: Cromite web content-setting 71 read-only probe
patches.description: Opt-in diagnostic hook; runtime preference defaults to disabled.

patches.name: Cromite web darkening final boolean return probe
patches.description: Optional read-only log of final native force-dark decision; max 64 samples per process.

patches.name: Cromite web theme policy native decision trace
patches.description: Safe opt-in tracing at the native WebContents darkening decision; does not yet alter rendering.

patches.name: Hide Android status bar
patches.description: Uses the native Force Tablet Mode switch to hide status icons in browser and Settings; requires AMOLED runtime patch.

patches.name: Hide status bar in Settings
patches.description: Synchronizes Settings status bar visibility with native Force Tablet Mode when window focus returns.

patches.name: Pure AMOLED / Pure White system theme
patches.description: Resolves pure black/white semantic surfaces at runtime using the AMOLED dialog selection and Android night mode.

patches.name: Translate Cromite to Spanish
patches.description: Adds Spanish translations for Cromite-specific settings.
